definition: expression is hard-eligible when a K=5 set exists whose target is the argmax-IoU proposal (IoU >= 0.5), whose 4 distractors are COCO same-category objects (proposal -> highest-IoU COCO GT with IoU >= 0.5) and whose target-equivalent proposals were removed - the A8 rule verbatim

matched_control.criterion: every hard-eligible expression must also admit the random K=5 view of the same sentence/image/target (section 17)
